name: the speak plugin: read aloud, rate, stop, and a reply read with the screen off (COI-3466)

args: settings get secure tts_default_synth; cmd package list packages | grep -i -E 'tts|speech' | head -5

steps.js: window.__TAURI__.core.invoke('plugin:speak|speak',{"id": "r1", "text": "Read it to me. This is a test of the speak plugin."}).then(v=>JSON.stringify(v)).catch(e=>'REJECTED '+JSON.stringify(e))

window.__TAURI__.core.invoke('plugin:speak|speak',{"id": "r2", "text": "one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen", "rate": 1.0}).then(v=>JSON.stringify(v)).catch(e=>'REJECTED '+JSON.stringify(e))
